Templates

Live templates

21 complete pages in 6 families. Every thumbnail is the real page running live. Open one to see it at any screen size, break it into parts and copy any section.

Landing page 1 page

  • Acme Cloud

    Landing page template: hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ and newsletter signup. Dependency-free HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

Website 6 pages

  • Strategy, design and engineering

    Multi-page website template: home page with hero, services, results, case study, testimonials, latest articles and a call to action.

  • About us

    About page template: company story, values with accessibility statement, milestones and team grid.

  • A practical guide to WCAG 2.2

    Article template using the docs layout: series navigation, readable article with code sample and figure, and an on-this-page table of contents.

  • Blog

    Blog listing template using the sidebar-right layout: article cards, search, categories, newsletter and pagination.

  • Contact

    Contact page template using the split layout: validated enquiry form beside contact details, office map and privacy note.

  • Services

    Services page template using the sidebar-left layout: sticky section navigation, service details and FAQ.

Dashboard 6 pages

  • Overview

    Admin dashboard template: KPI cards with sparklines, revenue and channel charts, recent orders grid, workspace tabs and a report dialog.

  • Analytics

    Analytics dashboard: interactive SVG line, area, bar, horizontal bar, donut and sparkline charts driven by JSON data, with a date range picker.

  • AI assistant

    Ask-your-data assistant inside the dashboard: questions about sales, orders and customers answered with streamed text, tool steps and live charts.

  • Customers

    Customers page: segment donut and spend charts plus a searchable customer grid loaded from JSON.

  • Orders

    Orders page: searchable, filterable, sortable data grid loaded from JSON with pagination, CSV export and an order detail dialog.

  • Settings

    Settings page: profile form, theme customizer, data source connection for charts and grids, and notification preferences.

E-commerce 3 pages

  • Shop all products

    E-commerce product listing template: filters, sorting, product cards with lazy-loaded images, cart counter and pagination.

  • Your cart

    Shopping cart template: editable line items, promo code validation, order summary with shipping and tax, and an empty state.

  • Studio wireless headphones

    Product detail template: CSS-only image gallery, colour swatches, quantity stepper, add to cart, specifications and a review breakdown chart.

AI apps 2 pages

  • AI assistant

    Full-page AI assistant template: streaming replies, Markdown and code blocks, tool steps, sources, file attachments, message actions and saved conversations.

  • Agent workspace

    Agent workspace template: chat with a multi-step coding agent alongside a live run panel showing the plan, step status, tool calls and generated artifacts.

Authentication 3 pages

  • Sign in

    Sign-in page template with accessible validation, password visibility toggle and remember-me option.

  • Reset password

    Forgot-password page template: single email field with validation and a privacy-preserving confirmation message.

  • Create account

    Registration page template with inline validation, password requirements, confirm-password matching and terms consent.
